purpose: Audit whether each runtime content layer has evidence of the correct authority type and define qualification gates for incomplete areas.

layers.notes: England statutory placements and Common Core codes resolve from primary standards. China resolves to the 2022 national learning stage/section; some China details remain partially verified where direct page extraction is unavailable.
Use learning stage + domain + section hierarchy. printed_page remains null; never invent a page number.
Exact Grade 1-6 semester/unit placement remains gated. National-stage mode is the runtime fallback.
Language-independent evidence is resolved by concept_id; English copy does not require a separate evidence source list.

layers.coverage: Canonical representation catalog includes system status/source IDs
layers.notes: When current China use is unverified, describe the representation as a useful option rather than a China-vs-West frequency difference.

layers.coverage: Canonical teaching-move catalog includes rationale/source IDs
layers.notes: Use guidance/research for Why sections; teaching moves are selected by concept fit, not national stereotype.
Many misconception records are curriculum_inferred rather than empirical prevalence findings. Keep wording as possible misunderstanding and require follow-up probes.
Each base task has source_ids and linked representations/moves. This supports the task rationale, not a national-use claim.

layers.coverage: Core comparison copy and classroom tasks fully stored in zh/en
layers.notes: Evidence IDs/statuses remain unchanged across language switch.

may_show_without_special_warning: Stored comparison explanations that preserve source status
Pedagogical options supported by guidance/research without national-frequency claims
may_show_with_qualification: China stage-level requirement where page-level direct extraction remains incomplete
System-specific representation use with partially verified/current-specifics-pending status
must_not_show_as_fact: Unverified exact current PEP grade/semester/unit placement
National method-frequency claims inferred from curriculum/guidance
Stable misconception diagnosis from one pupil response
